name: Aria Spark
summary:
Aria Spark transforms your Meta Quest into a spatial design studio. Powered by AI and real-time depth mapping, it turns any room into a live canvas where you can visualize changes, test ideas, and make confident decisions — before you buy, build, or hire.

*  **Material Swap:** See your kitchen with marble countertops, your living room with hardwood floors, or your bedroom with new wall colors — all rendered live in your actual space.

*  **Room Makeover:** Describe your vision — "mid-century modern living
